title: Button
description: A tactile button for interactive compositions (games, quizzes, menus played in the browser): primary (filled with the theme's accent), secondary (surface with a border) or ghost (text only). A pressed-in lip, a soft blur-free shadow, hover lift, a ripple from the finger, a springy release, a keyboard focus ring and an optional kit-icon; the label colour is chosen for 4.5:1 contrast. Emits press (with `value`) on a tap, Tab + Enter or its hotkeys; reacts to shake and pulse sent by the clip. Height is a share of the frame's short side (12 % by default: a thumb-sized target on a phone). Takes a theme.

label.description: The text on it (empty: an icon-only round button)

variant.description: primary: filled with the accent, for the one thing to do next; secondary: a surface button with a border; ghost: text only, tinted on hover

icon.description: A kit-icon name beside the label (arrow-right, play, check, x, star, rotate-ccw…); empty: none

hotkey.description: Keys that press it, comma separated (Enter, Escape, " " for space, 1, a, ArrowRight…); empty: none. Tab then Enter always works

value.description: Sent with press (read it as "$value" in a wire); empty: the label

disabled.description: Greyed out and not pressable; bind it ({ "$var": "locked" }) to enable it later

size.description: Height in % of the frame's short side (11 or more for a thumb on a phone)

width.description: Width in % of the box (0: hug the label)

align.description: Where it sits across its box

color.description: Fill of a primary button, text of a ghost one: a CSS colour (empty: the theme's accent)

idle.description: Idle motion of a primary button while it waits: a sheen sweeping across every few seconds, or a slow breath

delay.description: Seconds into the item before it pops in (stagger a row of buttons)

outDur.description: Seconds of the exit at the item's end. Keep 0 when the scene holds on its last frame for input
